blocks.text:
## Accommodation and beach stay

The programme includes 3 nights at Arena Leme in Rio de Janeiro, 2 nights at Vivaz Cataratas in Foz do Iguaçu and 2 nights at Vila Galé Salvador. The final 4 nights are at Pousada Casa do Forte in Praia do Forte, with breakfast.

Days 8–12 are spent in Praia do Forte. After the transfer from Salvador, check in at Pousada Casa do Forte and enjoy free days by the sea; on Day 12, transfer to the airport.

## Programme price

The price per person depends on room occupancy:

| Room occupancy | Price, USD |
|---|---:|
| Triple (TRP) | 3 986 |
| Double (DBL) | 4 284 |
| Single (SGL) | 7 823 |

The rate is based on 3 nights at Arena Leme, 2 nights at Vivaz Cataratas, 2 nights at Vila Galé Salvador and 4 nights at Pousada Casa do Forte. Room availability and the final price for the selected dates are confirmed at the time of booking.

Prices apply to arrivals in 2027, excluding trade fairs, festivals, Easter, New Year, Christmas and Carnival. International and domestic flights are charged separately.
